### Symbols for sets and maps

| Symbol | Meaning |
|---|---|
| $\mathbb N$ | natural numbers $1, 2, 3, \dots$; a page that counts from $0$ says so |
| $\mathbb Z$ | integers |
| $\mathbb Z_n$ | integers modulo $n$, the classes $[0], \dots, [n-1]$ |
| $\mathbb Q$ | rational numbers |
| $\mathbb R$ | real numbers |
| $\mathbb C$ | complex numbers |
| $\mathbb K$ | the field of scalars, $\mathbb R$ or $\mathbb C$ |
| $\mathbb H$ | quaternions |
| $[n]$ | the set $\{1, \dots, n\}$ |
| $\lfloor x\rfloor$, $\lceil x\rceil$ | floor and ceiling of a real number |
| $\iota: A \hookrightarrow X$ | inclusion of a subset |
| $d(x, y)$ | distance in a metric space; $d_1$, $d_2$, $d_\infty$ the taxicab, Euclidean and maximum metrics on $\mathbb R^n$ |
| $\ell_\infty(S)$ | bounded real functions on a set $S$, with the sup metric |
| $\lvert A\rvert$ | number of elements of a finite set $A$ |
| $\mathrm{id}_X$ | identity map of a set $X$ |
| $f \circ g$ | composition, $(f\circ g)(x) = f(g(x))$ |
| $f^{-1}(V)$ | preimage of a set $V$ under $f$ |
| $X/{\sim}$ | quotient of $X$ by an equivalence relation $\sim$ |
| $\overline{A}$ | closure of a set $A$ |
| $\partial\Omega$ | boundary of a region $\Omega$ |
| $B_\varepsilon(p)$ | open ball of radius $\varepsilon$ about $p$ |
| $\mathbb 1_A$, $\mathbb 1[\cdot]$ | indicator: $1$ on $A$ (or when the condition in brackets holds) and $0$ otherwise |
| $\arg\min_x f(x)$, $\arg\max_x f(x)$ | a minimiser, a maximiser of $f$ |
